title: How did you end up in tech, and are you staying?
why_read: A personal story about how someone ended up in tech is engaging community content but has no technical substance for a professional engineering digest.
analysis: The piece is a first-person narrative about the author's path from a robotics-club student to a career in tech via a detour through Development Planning. It is well-written and human but entirely anecdotal. There are no technical concepts, code, architecture decisions, or engineering lessons. This belongs in a community forum thread, not a curated technical digest.
